description_1: I am a student who focuses on website development. I am committed to always maintaining high-quality standards in every work and contribution I produce. I have an interest in pursuing a career as a Front-End Web Developer. I am also interested in digital illustration and 3D, which I integrate with programming to create engaging visual experiences in websites and interactive applications.
backend_description: A backend developer works in the 'kitchen' and 'storage' of an application — the part users never see but that keeps everything running. They manage data storage, process requests, connect the app to databases, and make sure everything is handled securely and efficiently. Like a chef and warehouse manager, a backend developer ensures the recipe is prepared correctly, stock is recorded, and incoming orders are processed until they’re ready to be delivered.
fullstack_description: A full stack developer is someone skilled in building both the front-end (the part users see) and the back-end (the behind-the-scenes systems) of an application or website. Simply put, they can create the interface that users interact with and also manage the systems that process data and run the app’s functions. It’s like building a store where the full stack developer designs the storefront for customers while also organizing the kitchen and storage to make sure every order is handled smoothly.
frontend_description: A frontend developer creates the look and feel of an application or website — the part users directly see and interact with. They design layouts, colors, buttons, and interactions so the experience is smooth and intuitive. Like a decorator and cashier arranging a store’s display, they make sure everything looks appealing and reacts properly when clicked or touched.

books_app_description: Bookhouse is an online platform that offers a wide variety of books to meet your literacy needs. With a user-friendly interface, Bookhouse makes it easy for you to find and purchase your favorite books from various genres and renowned authors.
keterlambatan_app_description: This application simplifies the real-time management of student tardiness data for School Administrators and Student Advisors. With an automated recording system, it enhances administrative efficiency and offers customizable reports based on specific time periods. The user-friendly and responsive interface ensures easy access across various devices. Key features include real-time tardiness recording, time-based filters for data analysis, and an interactive dashboard presenting statistics in an intuitive way. The technology stack uses Laravel 10 for the backend and HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript for the frontend.

experience_wikrama_2023: In this year, I officially became a tenth-grade student at SMK Wikrama Bogor, majoring in Software and Game Development (PPLG). During my first year, I learned various fundamental concepts in programming, including data types, basic algorithms, algorithm visualization using flowcharts, arrays, basic programming logic with JavaScript, and introductory PHP. In addition to technical skills (hardskills), I was also trained in soft skills, such as public speaking and teamwork, which will be highly valuable for my future.
experience_wikrama_2024: In my second year as an eleventh-grade student, I began to deepen my knowledge of programming languages and develop more complex applications. I also learned to work with libraries, frameworks, and databases such as Laravel, React, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and others. This year, I also prepared myself for the Qualification Test as a requirement to take part in the first internship program (PKL) scheduled for six months, from January to June 2025.
experience_wikrama_2025: In this year, after completing my internship, I prepared myself to work on Project Work and take the Competency Test. Moreover, I focused on studying for higher education entrance, particularly through the National Selection Based on Achievement (SNBP) and the National Selection Based on Test (SNBT).
experience_mtr_2025: After successfully passing the Qualification Test for the first internship period, I was placed at PT. Median Talenta Raya. During my internship at this company, I gained a great deal of knowledge and experience, ranging from Back-End development using Python and the Django framework, to Front-End development with Vue.js and Nuxt.js. In addition, I was introduced to Quality Assurance, which included Ethical Hacking, Functional Testing, and Non-Functional Testing (NFT). I also learned about Technical Writing and other important aspects of the IT field. In this internship, I worked as a Back-End Developer, responsible for building APIs using Python and Django. Some of the projects I completed include the Community App and Ngetag. This internship was a very meaningful experience, as it not only improved my technical skills but also expanded my network with IT professionals. At the end of the program, I was awarded an internship certificate for successfully completing the six-month program.
experience_freelancer_2025: In my spare time, I began learning how to build personal branding and pursue freelancing, equipped with the knowledge I gained from my previous learning and experiences.
